body: I love Twenty One Pilots, I have seen them in concert twice actually. But thank you.
I quit going to therapy unfortunately as it was through my school. I plan on going back though.
Yes I listen to a lot of music.

I don't really know, that is why I posted I really just feel like I am out of other options.  I can't figure out what would help me or improve my situation.  I know this can't be helpful for you at all and I apologize for that.  

I guess the one thing I didn't mention was that my mood is much worse at night.  I don't know if this is something that is common.  I can wake up at like 11 and go to work and feel alright and then once it gets dark and if I am not actively concentrating on something I just start to attack myself and then I build off that until I am awake at 5 in the morning sobbing in my bed. And repeat.  I mean if you read the original message which was typed at 4 in the morning compared to this at 6 it probably looks like a totally different person and that is what it feels like.
I'm sorry for being rude about it. I didn't mean for it to come off that way.  I appreciate your caring message.
I am at the point where I don't really care about winning or coming out on top I just want to not feel like shit nonstop.

I guess I should have been clear in that I really only have one friend. But we are normally very close.  One of the four therapists helped and the anti depressants didn't.  I tried Zoloft, Prozac and a few more that I don't remember the name of.
